fixtureOverlay.mechanism: recipe/fixtures/library-comboboxes.ts cloneTokens copies the CANONICAL fixture token tree (recipe/fixtures/combobox.ts) and renames every variable under mui.autocomplete.* / antd.select.*, mutating only ~8 paths per library (widths, trigger/option heights, highlighted/selected fills, error border, loading control, filled background). Every other channel keeps the canonical fallback while wearing a library-scoped name.
channelsThatAreCanonicalNotLibraryNamed: overlay chrome: fill #ffffff, border #d1d5db, radius 6, shadow 12px #00000026 — shared verbatim by both minted libraries; the v41 diagnosis itself classifies this chrome as 'shared by this fixture'

listPadding 4/0/4/0 — canonical fixture value; MUI's own source names listbox padding '8px 0' and noOptions/loading status padding '14px 16px' (diagnosis rawLibrarySource), which were never carried compile facts
optionPaddingX 10/12 — canonical formula 10+scale*2; MUI's own option padding is 16 horizontal per the diagnosis
occupancy placeholder squares and content strings (Assignee / Ada Lovelace / No options / Loading…) — declared fixture chrome
fixtureOverlay.notAnArtifact: Roboto on AntD is NOT fixture invention — extract/computed/configs/antd.json documents Roboto as the 4th entry of AntD's OWN declared font stack and the pin as choosing one of the library's own faces (FC-FONT-SUBSTRATE closure). Roboto on MUI is MUI's own first-choice stack.

combobox.whyThisIsMilderThanCalendarV30: V30 misrepresented the component's STRUCTURE (3-week month, no nav). Combobox structure — trigger/input/popup/listbox/option anatomy, open/empty/loading states, trigger heights 40/56 vs 24/32, borders, selected fills, loading blues — is source-named and survived distinctly. The fixture layer is the decorative overlay chrome. It was also NOT hidden: the v41 diagnosis named it before TJ's pass ('TJ's identical look is fixture-accurate for that chrome') and TJ passed after reading it.
combobox.whatTjShouldKnow: TJ's pass was conditioned on the empty/loading padding being 'accurate'. It is accurate to the COMPILE (no mint loss) and fixture-consistent, but it is NOT MUI-named: MUI's own source puts 8px vertical padding on the listbox and 14/16 on the No-options/Loading status slots. Under the new Astryx-source doctrine, the combobox overlay chrome is the one place in a passed archetype where a fixture overlay shaped what TJ saw.
combobox.remintScopeIfTjWantsIt: teach the adapters to land library-named overlay/list chrome instead of canonical fallbacks — MUI: Paper radius/shadow, listbox '8px 0', status-slot 14/16, option paddingX 16; AntD: dropdown paddingXXS, borderRadiusLG, its own shadow token, empty-item optionPadding — one teaching class per PREPARE, then a fresh mint on a new Scratch page and a fresh human grade. The existing V41 page and signoff stay untouched either way.
